headline: University Of Indonesia Clarifies Sekolah Rakyat Location Plans
metaDescription: The University of Indonesia clarified that the proposed Sekolah Rakyat site is on campus land, refuting reports it would displace city forest areas.
aiSummaryBullets: The University of Indonesia stated that the proposed eight-hectare site for the Sekolah Rakyat project is within campus boundaries.
University officials clarified that the designated land does not overlap with the existing city forest zone.
The Ministry of Social Affairs previously announced the initiative, which aims to provide educational access to students.
aiContextParagraph: The Ministry of Social Affairs, led by Minister Saifullah Yusuf, has introduced plans to establish Sekolah Rakyat across Indonesia, an initiative supported by President Prabowo Subianto. The program aims to address dropout rates and provide educational recovery resources for children, with a target of establishing 500 schools serving one million students. A recent focal point of the development has been the selection of an eight-hectare site at the University of Indonesia. Following media reports suggesting that the construction would require clearing the university's protected forest area, university officials issued a clarification. They emphasized that the identified development plot is part of the campus land and does not infringe upon the city forest designated for conservation. The university confirmed its ongoing cooperation with the central government to facilitate the project's development within proper land-use regulations.
whyItIsViral: The story is being covered by five independent outlets following public and media confusion regarding the impact of the school construction on protected forest lands.
